propositions: Live test_provider_matrix_live.py:88 fails with AssertionError because resolved openai specs are canonicalized to 'openai-chat:' qualifier but guard compares literally against 'openai' family name.

Credential lookup in _live_llm.py:46-50 has no 'openai-chat' entry, causing configured_provider()='openai-chat' to report credential_present()=False and live_llm_ready()=False, skipping all llm_live tests on openai arm.

Unit-tier matrix gate (_MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER in tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py:73) was updated in commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 to map openai-chat qualifier to openai family, but live external tier was not updated, creating an unmet consumer obligation.

Fix adds qualifier-to-family map (_PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER) and provider_family() helper to _live_llm.py so configured_provider() returns family name instead of qualifier, aligning all consumers with REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER.

Live test guard comparisons must check resolved qualifier's family (via provider_family()) against declared arm provider family instead of literal prefix match to restore arm readiness without weakening guard teeth.
